source.author: Dekolte
source.note: Archive AMIKO_MicroHD_Galaxy_1.6.10_by Dekolte.rar from the Amiko / Amiko HD directory on satedu.cba.pl; fetched 2026-11-02.

simulator.note: Boots as the single-CPU M3801 family (chips/m3801.py, run_dump_microhd_galaxy_1610_app_starts.py, run_dump_microhd_galaxy_1610_capture_screen.py): the "M3612 1.0.4" bootloader prints "APP  init ok / bl_panel_init! / -->>ch455!!", writes " ON " to the CH455 panel on GPIO 31 / 9, verifies and unpacks maincode(AV) ("0E000A001610") to 0x80000200, and enters the application (CP0 EBase 0x80002000).  With the ALi S3501 DVB-S2 demodulator attached at I2C 0x33 on SCB0, the application updates the CH455 front panel to "-ON-" and enables GMA layer 0 to display its 1280x720 OSD dialog.

desc: Amiko Micro HD (System ID 0E000A00, Galaxy v1.6.10 by Dekolte) firmware (2015-03-10) on an 8 MB SPI flash for the single-CPU ALi M3612 (S3811 DVB-S2 variant) compact Full HD satellite receiver.
Pairs the single-CPU M3801/S3811 SoC architecture with an external ALi S3501 DVB-S2 demodulator at I2C 0x33 on SCB0 and a CH455 4-digit LED panel on GPIO 31 / 9 (" ON " -> "-ON-").
